verdict.rationale: Synctera documents several payment rails (ACH, domestic wires, internal transfers, RDC) and webhooks. None of the evidence describes the transaction data model itself: no counterparty fields, rail-specific metadata, stable transaction identifiers, or merchant/category enrichment. Plaid/Finicity retrieval of external-account transactions is a verification feature from partners, not enrichment of Synctera's own feed, so it earns no credit here.
